### New

- **Update pop-up.** When a new version has downloaded, a notice pops up in the corner straight away, even on the main menu, telling you to restart Minecraft. The chat message is still there too.
- **Keep off players.** A new World setting moves floating words out of the way whenever they sit on top of another player, fading words included, so they never cover someone in PvP. Turn it off if you'd rather they stay put.
- **Hit to knock.** Another World setting: swing at a floating word and it gets knocked back with a flash, then springs back into place.

### Fixed

- **Words in the floor.** Floating words check their whole face for blocks, not just the corners, and words gliding out of each other's way no longer slide into the ground or a wall; they go over the top instead.
